name: govern-rebuttal
description: Use when writing the response to a Governance: An International Journal of Policy, Administration, and Institutions revise-and-resubmit. The response must convert each of the ≥ 2 referees and the editor, answering comparative-reviewer concerns (case selection, generalizability across countries, measurement of institutions, alternative institutional explanations) point by point. Structures the response letter; it does not fabricate new results.
